specialties.name: General Medicine
specialties.description: Comprehensive adult primary care, acute illness management, and chronic disease prevention.

specialties.name: Cardiology
specialties.description: Diagnosis and medical management of heart diseases, vascular disorders, and cardiovascular prevention.

specialties.name: Neurology
specialties.description: Investigation and treatment of central, peripheral, and autonomic nervous system disorders.

specialties.name: Neurosurgery
specialties.description: Surgical treatment of brain, spinal cord, spinal column, and peripheral nerves.

specialties.name: Orthopedics
specialties.description: Preservation and restoration of the musculoskeletal system, joints, bones, ligaments, and tendons.

specialties.name: Pediatrics
specialties.description: Medical care of infants, children, and adolescents from birth up to 18 years of age.

specialties.name: Dermatology
specialties.description: Medical and surgical management of disorders affecting skin, hair, and nails.

specialties.name: Psychiatry
specialties.description: Diagnosis, prevention, and treatment of mental, emotional, and behavioral disorders.

specialties.name: Psychology
specialties.description: Psychological assessment, psychotherapy, cognitive behavioral therapy, and counseling.

specialties.name: Gynecology
specialties.description: Medical and surgical care of the female reproductive system and breasts.

specialties.name: Obstetrics
specialties.description: Comprehensive pregnancy, prenatal, childbirth, and postpartum maternal-fetal care.

specialties.name: Oncology
specialties.description: Multidisciplinary diagnosis, chemotherapy, immunotherapy, and targeted treatment of cancer.

specialties.name: Gastroenterology
specialties.description: Diagnosis and endoscopic management of digestive tract, liver, gallbladder, and pancreatic disorders.

specialties.name: Nephrology
specialties.description: Medical care of kidney function, chronic kidney disease, dialysis, and kidney transplantation.

specialties.name: Urology
specialties.description: Surgical and medical diseases of male and female urinary-tract system and male reproductive organs.

specialties.name: Pulmonology
specialties.description: Diagnosis and treatment of respiratory tract and lung diseases, sleep apnea, and allergy care.

specialties.name: Endocrinology
specialties.description: Hormonal disorders, metabolic regulation, thyroid dysfunction, and complex diabetes management.

specialties.name: Rheumatology
specialties.description: Systemic autoimmune diseases, connective tissue disorders, and inflammatory arthritis.

specialties.name: Ophthalmology
specialties.description: Medical and microsurgical eye care, cataract surgery, glaucoma, and refractive corrections.

specialties.name: ENT
specialties.description: Ear, Nose, Throat, head and neck surgery, sinus surgery, and hearing assessment.

specialties.name: Dentistry
specialties.description: Oral health, conservative dentistry, endodontics, prosthodontics, and dental hygiene.

specialties.name: General Surgery
specialties.description: Laparoscopic and open surgical procedures for abdominal organs, hernias, and soft tissues.

specialties.name: Plastic Surgery
specialties.description: Reconstructive surgery, wound care, microsurgery, burn management, and cosmetic procedures.

specialties.name: Pediatric Surgery
specialties.description: Specialized surgical treatment for infants, children, and adolescents with congenital anomalies.

specialties.name: Neonatology
specialties.description: Intensive medical care of newborn infants, especially ill or premature newborns.

specialties.name: Emergency Medicine
specialties.description: Acute resuscitation, trauma stabilization, medical emergencies, and poison management.

specialties.name: Critical Care
specialties.description: Intensive care management of patients with life-threatening medical conditions and organ failure.

specialties.name: Radiology
specialties.description: Diagnostic medical imaging including MRI, CT, Ultrasound, X-Ray, and Image-guided Interventions.

specialties.name: Anesthesiology
specialties.description: Perioperative care, general anesthesia, regional nerve blocks, and acute/chronic pain medicine.

specialties.name: Physiotherapy
specialties.description: Musculoskeletal rehabilitation, neurological physical therapy, post-surgical mobility recovery.
